name: Floor straw sack
description: A coarse hemp sack of straw on a few old planks, with a sheepskin and a threadbare blanket; the bed of the poorest households and of the children and servants of a crowded house.

visual.look: Lumpy patched straw sack on split planks, grey sheepskin and threadbare dark wool blanket, straw spilling from a torn corner.
